# vpsie_bare_metal (Resource)

Orders a dedicated (bare-metal) server, installs its operating system and keeps its hostname, project, administrator password and private networks in step with the configuration. Destroying the resource releases the server, which wipes its disks; this needs `account_password` on the provider.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "bare_metal_password" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

data "vpsie_bare_metal_plans" "gpu" {
  dc_identifier = "dc-identifier"
  gpu           = true
  min_ram_gb    = 128
}

data "vpsie_bare_metal_os" "ubuntu" {
  dc_identifier   = "dc-identifier"
  plan_identifier = data.vpsie_bare_metal_plans.gpu.plans[0].identifier
}

resource "vpsie_bare_metal" "example" {
  dc_identifier   = "dc-identifier"
  plan_identifier = data.vpsie_bare_metal_plans.gpu.plans[0].identifier
  os_identifier = one([
    for os in data.vpsie_bare_metal_os.ubuntu.operating_systems : os.identifier
    if os.distribution == "Ubuntu" && os.is_default
  ])
  hostname            = "gpu-01.example.com"
  password            = var.bare_metal_password
  ssh_key_identifiers = ["ssh-key-identifier"]
  contract_term       = "monthly"
  private_network_ids = [vpsie_vpc.example.id]

  remote_access = {
    enabled             = true
    firewall_identifier = "firewall-group-identifier"
  }

  user_data = <<-EOT
    #cloud-config
    packages:
      - nvidia-utils-550-server
  EOT

  release_reason = "Replaced by Terraform"

  timeouts = {
    create = "90m"
    delete = "45m"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `dc_identifier` (String) Identifier of the datacenter to order the server in. Changing this value orders a new server and releases the current one, except when the value is set for the first time on a server adopted with terraform import.
- `hostname` (String) Hostname of the server, at most 253 characters. Changed in place.
- `os_identifier` (String) Identifier of the operating system (`bmos_...`), from the `vpsie_bare_metal_os` data source. The API does not return it, so an imported server takes it from the configuration. Changing this value orders a new server and releases the current one, except when the value is set for the first time on a server adopted with terraform import.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Administrator (root) password: 8 to 128 printable ASCII characters, without double quotes, backslashes or double curly braces. Changing it resets the password in place: the server powers off, boots a reset job and starts again, which takes several minutes.
- `plan_identifier` (String) Identifier of the hardware plan, from the `vpsie_bare_metal_plans` data source. The API does not return it, so an imported server takes it from the configuration. Changing this value orders a new server and releases the current one, except when the value is set for the first time on a server adopted with terraform import.

### Optional

- `contract_term` (String) Billing term: `hourly` or `monthly`, one of the plan's `contract_terms`. Defaults to the plan's term. Changing this value orders a new server and releases the current one, except when the value is set for the first time on a server adopted with terraform import.
- `dns_zone_identifier` (String) Identifier of an account DNS zone in which to create the server's record. Changing this value orders a new server and releases the current one, except when the value is set for the first time on a server adopted with terraform import.
- `link_speed_mbps` (Number) Uplink speed in Mbit/s, one of the plan's `link_speed_options`. Defaults to the plan's speed. Changing this value orders a new server and releases the current one, except when the value is set for the first time on a server adopted with terraform import.
- `private_network_ids` (Set of Number) IDs of the VPCs (`vpsie_vpc.id`) to attach, at most 8. Attached and detached in place; Terraform waits until each change is done. Without the attribute Terraform leaves the attachments alone.
- `project_identifier` (String) Identifier of the project the server belongs to. Changed in place (the server moves).
- `release_note` (String) Note recorded when Terraform releases the server.
- `release_reason` (String) Reason recorded when Terraform releases the server. Defaults to `Destroyed by Terraform`.
- `remote_access` (Attributes) Remote-access firewall rules written at install time. Without the block the server opens SSH (or RDP on Windows) to the internet. Changing this value orders a new server and releases the current one, except when the value is set for the first time on a server adopted with terraform import. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--remote_access))
- `script_identifiers` (List of String) Identifiers of the account's saved scripts to run on first boot, in the listed order (at most 5, each once). Changing the order also orders a new server. Changing this value orders a new server and releases the current one, except when the value is set for the first time on a server adopted with terraform import.
- `ssh_key_identifiers` (Set of String) Identifiers of the account's SSH keys to install (at most 10). Changing this value orders a new server and releases the current one, except when the value is set for the first time on a server adopted with terraform import.
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))
- `user_data` (String, Sensitive) Cloud-init user data run on first boot: a document starting with `#cloud-config` or a script starting with `#!`, at most 64 KB. Changing this value orders a new server and releases the current one, except when the value is set for the first time on a server adopted with terraform import.

### Read-Only

- `delivery_hours` (Number) Hours a build-to-order server takes to deliver, as quoted at order time.
- `deployed_at` (String) When the operating system was installed.
- `gateway` (String) Gateway of the primary address.
- `id` (String) The server identifier.
- `identifier` (String) The server identifier.
- `ip_address` (String) Primary public IPv4 address.
- `netmask` (String) Netmask of the primary address.
- `order_status` (String) `sold` once the server is on the account, `pending_build` while a build-to-order server is assembled.
- `os_family` (String) `linux` or `windows`.
- `os_name` (String) Name of the installed operating system.
- `os_phase` (String) OS state: `installing`, `reinstalling`, `password_reset`, `running` or `failed`.
- `power_state` (String) Power state reported by the server's BMC.
- `status` (String) State shown in the portal: `ordered`, `installing`, `reinstalling`, `ready`, `failed`, `powered_off`, `deleting` or `suspended`.

<a id="nestedatt--remote_access"></a>
### Nested Schema for `remote_access`

Optional:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Open SSH (Linux) or RDP (Windows). Defaults to `true`.
- `firewall_identifier` (String) Identifier of an account firewall group to apply instead of the open rules.
- `winrm` (Boolean) Also open WinRM on a Windows server. Defaults to `false`.


<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) How long to wait for the order and the OS install (default 60m). An order whose answer is lost (no answer, 502/503/504, Cloudflare 52x) is resent with the same idempotency key within this time; one still unconfirmed at the end is looked up by hostname and adopted.
- `delete` (String) How long to wait for the release (default 30m).
- `update` (String) How long to wait for a password reset and private network changes (default 60m).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Bare-metal servers are imported by their identifier. The API does not return
# the plan, OS, password or other install-time inputs, so the first apply after
# the import takes them from the configuration without replacing the server.
terraform import vpsie_bare_metal.example "bm-identifier"
```
